# 从原生文件定位源码

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

当游戏日志给出生成文件和原生行号时，使用输出来源信息定位产生该内容的 `.krg.ts` / `.krg.tsx`。查询应针对同一次构建的产物与映射；改变源码后重新构建，才能让原生位置与源位置保持对应。返回值与位置字段如下，完整排错流程见指南。

## 本页参考

- [traceOutput](#traceoutput)
- [traceGameLog](#tracegamelog)
- [TracedLocation](#tracedlocation)
- [TracedLogEntry](#tracedlogentry)

## traceOutput() { #traceoutput }

> **traceOutput**(`project`: `string`, `path`: `string`, `generatedLine`: `number`): [`TracedLocation`](#tracedlocation)

Defined in: [src/project/trace.ts:31](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/trace.ts#L31)

Locate a generated line in authoring source. Refuses edited native bytes rather than reporting a stale location.

### Parameters { #traceoutput-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `project` | `string` |
| `path` | `string` |
| `generatedLine` | `number` |

### Returns { #traceoutput-section-returns }

[`TracedLocation`](#tracedlocation)

### Example { #traceoutput-section-example }

```ts
const location = traceOutput('./my-mod', 'events/krg_example.txt', 12);
console.log(location.source, location.line, location.precision);
```
